entities.name: Ojer Pakpatiq
entities.description: The Oltec god of time, a Deep God of Ixalan's Core, second highest ranked after Ojer Taq; he takes the shape of a winged serpent.

entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: The people who revere the Deep Gods.

entities.name: Deep Gods
entities.description: The gods of Ixalan's Core, who can change their shape.

entities.name: Ixalan's Core
entities.description: The underground realm of the Deep Gods.

entities.name: Chimil
entities.description: Deity of whom Pakpatiq is believed to be a child.

entities.name: Ojer Taq
entities.description: The highest ranked Oltec god and lover of Ojer Pakpatiq.

entities.name: Oteclan
entities.description: Site of Pakpatiq's Temple of Cyclical Time, second largest in the core.

relations.note: Believed to be a child of Chimil.
relations.quote: he is believed to be a child of Chimil
Ojer Pakpatiq is the lover of Ojer Taq and the second god of the Oltec.
Didacts serve as the priests of Ojer Pakpatiq.
As one of the Deep Gods of Ixalan's Core
